Madhya Pradesh Approves Five New Industrial Parks, Targeting Jobs and Investment

The state of Madhya Pradesh has approved the establishment of five new industrial parks. The initiative aims to create approximately 314,000 jobs and attract an investment of ₹70,650 crore. This expansion is intended to boost industrial development within the state.
